list.text: Huh? You'd like to go up against me? Great!
I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of Trainer you'll become.
Hmmm...\nI don't know what to do...
You looked strong.\nI was afraid to take you on...
Youngster: Goodness, how rude! Call me Shorts Boy!
Looks like I need a bit more training!
How about you just slow down and give me the chance to defeat you!

lines: EndSpeech: Quando eu capturar um novo POKEMON, eu vencerei!

list.text: Even though you're so young, you have the spirit of battle within.
You must have trained under a well-known master!
I can run like the wind!
I wear shorts the whole year round.\nThat's my fashion policy.
My Bag is digging into my shoulders!\nWhen that happens I like to take a break and have a battle!
All right, guess I should carry my Bag again!
Peace!
When you meet the unknown on a mountain road, all you want is peace, right?
Exchanging lighthearted greetings with someone you don't know...
That's the best thing about mountains!
Step right up and take a look!
The greatest fire-breather in Kanto, that's me.
But not the best Trainer...
Mt. Moon ahead.\nMt. Moon Square is on the way to the top!
\f[faceyellow]\rHey, good to see you again!
\f[faceyellow]\rWe were searching for Red in the Victory Road, but he's not there...
\f[faceyellow]\rSo our next idea is to look for him in the Mt. Moon, as all that Pika remembers is that they were in a cave last time.
\f[faceyellow]\rAre you going there?!
\f[faceyellow]\rIn this case I think all of us can go together!
\PN teamed up with Yellow and Pikachu!\me[Item get]\wtnp[40]
We should go to Mt. Moon, can't go back to Pewter.
